dogecoin.text: Poll for $TSLA shareholders: If @Tesla swaps out $BTC held in their treasury for $DOGE, you:
@davidgokhshtein If they are so bullish on $DOGE, why wouldn't they have a position already?

@davidgokhshtein Interesting thought. Though $TSLA chose to buy $BTC instead of $DOGE to hold on their books. Additionally, when Tesla announced they would no longer accept BTC for payment, they also said they were not selling any BTC.

@lawlerrskates @todd_0_matic @elonmusk @heydave7 Curious, how much of Elon's net worth do you think is actual cash that he could use to purchase $DOGE vs. a notional value based on his equity ownership of his companies?
